name: "General Tso's" Tempeh with Green Onion, Bok Choy, Sesame Seeds & Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
2 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
10 baby bok choy

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place ⅔ in a small bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Peel and mince ginger. Add to the bowl with the green onions along with broth, cornstarch, soy sauce, maple syrup, and ketchup. Stir to combine the stir-fry sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth
2 tbsp cornstarch
2 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp pure maple syrup
2 tbsp rice vinegar
2 tbsp ketchup

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, slice tempeh crosswise into ½-inch thick strips. Season with salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (8 oz) packages tempeh
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tempeh in a single layer and cook, flipping once, until browned and warmed through, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, trim and cut bok choy crosswise into bite-sized pieces.
Return the skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bok choy and salt, then stir-fry until softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp toasted sesame oil
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add stir-fry sauce to the skillet. Bring to a boil and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat, add tempeh, and stir to combine; cover to keep warm.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Top with reserved green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!
